title: Exotic Vietnamese Salmon Bun Rieu
description: A spicy and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring hot smoked flaked salmon, this recipe is paleo-friendly and full of flavor, with a crunchy texture from the added toppings.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the rendered pork fat over medium heat.
Add the diced tomato and cook until they start to break down.
Add the tamarind paste, fish sauce, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the sliced bird's eye chili to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flaked hot smoked salmon to the skillet and stir to combine with the tomato mixture.
To assemble the dish, place some cooked rice noodles in a bowl and add the salmon and tomato mixture on top.
Garnish with bean sprouts, chopped mint leaves, and crushed fried shallots.
Prepare all the toppings before assembling the dish for a quick and easy meal.
